scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: Expedition dinner tonight! Oliver, wash your hands — we're making pizza for the whole team.
scene.intro: Expedition dinner tonight — pizza! Oliver, wash your hands, says Ingrid, taking charge. Have we got any cheese? Yes, we've got some. Have we got any mushrooms? No, we haven't got any, so we'll use olives and onion instead. Put the tomato on first, then the cheese, then everything else. Into the oven for twelve minutes! What do YOU put on your pizza? Give the instructions!

activities.title: Listen to the pizza recipe. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Ingrid: Ready, Oliver? First, mix the flour with warm water. … Oliver: Done! It looks like a white ball. … Ingrid: Perfect. Now cut two tomatoes and one onion. … Oliver: Ouch — onions make my eyes cry! … Ingrid: Ha! Now add the cheese. We've got some yellow cheese from Grandpa's farm. … Oliver: Can I add mushrooms? … Ingrid: Yes, wash them first. But no olives — Diego doesn't like them. … Oliver: Okay! Into the oven? … Ingrid: Yes, for fifteen minutes. Then it's ready!
